How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIT Hyderabad Senior Consultant – Corporate Relations Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 22-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Hyderabad to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Hyderabad Senior Consultant post?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for the Senior Consultant – Corporate Relations position at IIT Hyderabad is 22nd September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Bachelor's degree with 5 years of relevant experience or a Master's degree with 3 years of relevant experience in corporate relations, fundraising, or administrative roles.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Senior Consultant position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Senior Consultant – Corporate Relations post is 40 years. Age relaxation is applicable as per government rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Senior Consultant role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 100000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. How will candidates be selected for this post?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Written Test, followed by a Skill Test, and an Interview.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this job?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is entirely online through the official IIT Hyderabad website.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the selection venue for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will take place at IIT Hyderabad, Kandi, Sangareddy, Telangana.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: This is a contractual position at IIT Hyderabad.

faq.question: Q10. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is IITH/CS/58.
